card.name: Science news site names and datelines
card.fires_on: Marks the end of a news-site name or dateline in science press-release text, such as Daily in ScienceDaily, Alert in EurekAlert!, or the dash after PhysOrg.com or a date. It also fires on the word right after a dateline.

modes.label: Site names
modes.description: The last part of a science news service name like ScienceDaily or EurekAlert!.

modes.label: Dateline break
modes.description: The dash or first word that follows a source name or date at the start of a news story.
modes.example: HAMBURG, Germany, June 19, 2012<< —>> The European X-ray Free-Electron Laser

card.plain: It lights up on the tags that open or close science press-release articles, like the site name or the date line.
